mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_chat_message (session_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, is_read, created_at, quote_message_id, quote_sender, quote_text) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{isRead}, 0), NOW(), #{quoteMessageId}, #{quoteSender}, #{quoteText})
mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id, m.session_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.msg_type, m.content, m.file_url, m.is_read, m.read_time, m.created_at, m.recalled, m.recalled_time, m.quote_message_id, m.quote_sender, m.quote_text, q.recalled AS quote_recalled, u.nick_name AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar FROM sys_chat_message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_chat_message q ON m.quote_message_id = q.message_id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
SELECT message_id, session_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, file_url, is_read, read_time, created_at, recalled, recalled_time FROM sys_chat_message WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
